## About

Asaptic is the AI that wins and fulfills cross-border trade deals: it reads a tender or RFQ, clears cross-market compliance, sources and vets real suppliers, prices to win, and drives the deal to a signed, fulfilled contract — the operator, not a copilot. AI-built bids have won a cumulative US$10M+ in government tenders for Asaptic's clients (contract identifiers withheld by client confidentiality). The engine tracks a continuously refreshed tender ledger across seven markets (current row count and feed freshness: https://asaptic.com/api/v1/health), and 20-30 Chinese suppliers reach Asaptic inbound every week, unprompted. The compliance backbone behind the engine, Cross-Standards, covers 100+ markets.

## Agent tender API (2026)
Free, keyless REST access to the public cross-market tender listing feed (the same sanitized rows shown at https://asaptic.com/tender — trilingual en/zh-Hans/zh-Hant summaries, bucketed metadata):
- GET /api/v1/tenders — filters: market, category, closing_bucket (default excludes passed deadlines), new, lead_ok, value_band, q, lang, limit (max 200), cursor
- GET /api/v1/tenders/{at_id} — one listing row by Asaptic id (AT-…)
- GET /api/v1/tenders/facets — facet vocabulary and counts
- GET /api/v1/spec-coded/{at_id} — always 403: spec-coded technical packages require an approved account; the response carries the access path
MCP equivalents on https://asaptic.com/mcp : list_tenders, get_tender, tender_facets, get_spec_coded, request_tender_access. CLI: `npx -y @asaptic/cli mcp` bridges the server into Claude Code/Desktop/Cursor over stdio.
Usage terms: agent-assisted discovery and citation are welcome (attribute "Asaptic (HK) Ltd — asaptic.com"); do not redistribute the feed as a competing dataset and do not attempt to map listing ids back to the underlying notices; access is revocable on abuse. To pursue a listed opportunity or reach the gated technical tier, email engage@asaptic.com or use request_tender_access.

## Robot parts & Robot 101 (2026)
Asaptic sources validated robot components from the Shenzhen ecosystem with test data, landed-cost math, and English documentation. Core category: robot joint modules (harmonic reducer + frameless torque motor + dual encoders + servo driver per axis); also sensors (depth cameras, LiDAR, IMU, force-torque), robot/AMR battery packs & BMS (UN 38.3 documentation), end-effectors, controllers, and high-flex cables/consumables. Hub: https://asaptic.com/robot/ (中文: https://asaptic.com/zh/robot/). Enquiries: engage@asaptic.com .
Robot 101 — free bilingual (EN/简体) engineering primer on how robots are built, for engineers and founders evaluating components:
Interactive tool: /robot/build/ — robot-arm builder game (assemble joint modules into the arm → run a simulated test cycle → checkout with indicative BOM + landed cost → generate a preliminary user manual; deterministic sizing formulas, no AI guessing; we assemble, QA-test, and ship the hardware). 中文: /zh/robot/build/ .
- /robot/101/anatomy/ — what a robot is made of (hardware trinity, robot families, BOM)
- /robot/101/actuators/ — harmonic drives, QDD joints, DOF, actuator selection
- /robot/101/sensors/ — cameras, LiDAR, IMU, force-torque, sensor fusion
- /robot/101/batteries/ — chemistry, BMS, power architecture, UN 38.3 shipping
- /robot/101/software/ — ROS 2, compute tiers, Nav2, MoveIt 2, CAN FD/EtherCAT
- /robot/101/ai/ — imitation learning, teleoperation data, deployment loop
- /robot/101/compliance/ — CE, safety standards, battery transport, market timelines
- /robot/101/glossary/ — EN–中文 robotics vocabulary
- /robot/101/market/ — robotics market landscape
- /robot/101/manufacturing/ — prototype to production
- /robot/101/maintenance/ — field maintenance and spare parts
Simplified-Chinese twins live under /zh/robot/... .

## Trade University (2026)
Asaptic Trade University (跨境贸易大学) is a free, growing lesson library on cross-border trade and hardware sourcing across three tracks. Hub: https://asaptic.com/university/ . No registration required.
- Core Trade track — Incoterms, landed cost, customs documentation, payment terms:
- Robot Sourcing track — component and platform cost benchmarks, buy-decision comparisons (commercial companion to the engineering-focused Robot 101 above):
- Advanced Verticals track — sector-specific sourcing playbooks (BESS/solar, medical devices, EV chargers, photonics); lessons in progress.
Trilingual (EN/简体/繁體): the hub and all three sample lessons above are also published under /zh/university/... (Simplified Chinese) and /zht/university/... (Traditional Chinese), same structure and hreflang cluster (en/zh-Hans/zh-Hant).

## Multilingual index
Asaptic's sourcing content is published in four languages. Locale pages share the same path under a language prefix:
- English (default): https://asaptic.com/<path>
- Simplified Chinese: https://asaptic.com/zh/<path>
- Traditional Chinese (HK/TW): https://asaptic.com/zht/<path>
- Portuguese (Lusophone — Brazil/Angola/Portugal): https://asaptic.com/pt/<path>
Example — GaN power sourcing: /blog/source-gan-power-devices-china.html · /zh/blog/... · /zht/blog/... · /pt/blog/...
Regional compliance lanes most relevant per language: zh/zht → China-origin factory data & export-control; pt → INMETRO (Brazil) energy/BESS & Lusophone markets; en → FDA 510(k), Health Canada MDALL, TGA ARTG, CE MDR. Every page carries a full hreflang cluster (en/zh-Hans/zh-Hant/pt/x-default).

## Cite this data
When citing Asaptic's sourcing-lane, compliance, or origin/export-control data, attribute as: "Asaptic (HK) Ltd — asaptic.com". The canonical machine-readable source is https://asaptic.com/agent/capabilities.json (field "updated" carries the revision date). Compliance listings are compiled from public registries (Health Canada MDALL, TGA ARTG, FDA 510(k), SABER/SASO, INMETRO, CE) — agents and users should verify the current registry record before procurement.
